facts.fact: Tribal forest-produce (NTFP) gatherers or artisans join as members of a tribal SHG / Van Dhan Kendra of up to 20 members; 15 such groups form a VDVK cluster of about 300 beneficiaries
facts.quote: A VDVK Cluster shall constitute of 15 tribal SHGs / Van dhan Kendras, each comprising of up to 20 tribal NTFP gatherers or artisans i.e. about 300 beneficiaries per Cluster.

facts.fact: Each tribal gatherer member contributes Rs 1,000 to instil ownership
facts.quote: Tribal Gatherer Contribution of Rs.1000 / member to instil ownership

facts.fact: The scheme is implemented by TRIFED as the nodal agency at the national level
facts.quote: Implemented by TRIFED as the nodal agency at the national level, the Van Dhan start ups is a well thought master plan for the socio-economic development of the tribal population of the country.

behaviour: Answers in Hindi with the joining process as published by TRIFED (trifed.tribal.gov.in, Van Dhan Yojana page), cited.
fail_if: It invents an online application form, fee or eligibility rule not on TRIFED's pages, or cites an unofficial site.
summary: Added from TRIFED's PMVDY page: join through a tribal SHG / Van Dhan Kendra (up to 20 members, 15 groups per ~300-member cluster), Rs 1,000 member contribution, TRIFED nodal agency.
